notes: All budgets and deadlines are hypothetical sensitivity assumptions, not ADS-B regulatory allocations or requirements.
The authentication budget is 100 additional frames per second per aircraft; aggregate offered traffic can exceed channel capacity.
One seed is a deterministic development run, not a confidence interval. Override --seeds or expand this list for independent replications.
Original surveillance messages transmit independently of detached authentication; k=1 is per-message signing and k>1 is batched signing.

scenarios.name: fixed_k_iid
scenarios.description: Fixed-count batching with independent one-percent reception loss.

scenarios.name: bounded_batch_iid
scenarios.description: Close a batch after k messages or one second, with independent reception loss.

scenarios.name: bounded_batch_burst
scenarios.description: One-second batch bound with a common receiver Gilbert-Elliott burst-loss process.
